notes: Play BlueSpark is here: a second way to play, next to Play TTT2. It has its own window for Ranked, lobbies, Training,...
The two buttons are now called Play TTT2 and Play BlueSpark
Play TTT2 and Play BlueSpark run the same game. Players on either one match each other in Quick Match, Ranked and lob...
Report a problem now always includes the log of the game you're playing, not only older ones
Ranked: MATCH FOUND shows your opponent's rating and characters while you accept
Lobbies: join one by its code, and press READY UP in the room when you're set
Training and replays start in seconds, because the game is kept ready behind the window
The live leaderboard: the top 100 with their rank emblems, and your own place
Rematches stay in the match: the next fight starts about 9 seconds after you both agree
Ranked: game 2 of a set always starts now, and each game of a set is on a different stage
Ranked: between games there's no way out of the set but the forfeit, so a stray B no longer counts as leaving
Ranked: the intro no longer shows PLACEMENT for characters that are already placed
Private lobbies: a lobby can be kept off the public list and joined by its code
A lobby on another release now says so, instead of just not connecting
Lobbies: a rematch no longer gets stuck under the loading cover
Lobbies: confirming the input delay with a button no longer sometimes starts the fight without the opponent's choice
A button held as you close one of our panels (a rematch vote, a rematch prompt, the input delay popup, Queue Options,...
Every character select panel is now unlocked, not just PANEL 1 (Customize, the last category)
Quick Select in Practice lists all 29 stages, the DLC stages too
A setting given twice when the game starts can no longer turn other settings off
name: Release 4.4
